title: Off-host backup: full-store copy to a directory target, honest local_backed_up
outcome: A project's store is copied whole to a configured directory target on the host's cadence, restored onto a clean home on demand, and reported as local_backed_up only under the rule in docs/features/off-host-backup.md, always with its off-host assurance.
acceptance: `engram backup push` writes a verified full-store copy, gzip-compressed, to a configured directory target and records a receipt; the store-equality test in the repository passes: a copy pushed from a source, restored with `engram backup restore` into a second clean home, yields exported rows equal to the rows exported from the source before the push

`engram backup status` and `engram doctor` report `local_backed_up` only when the freshness rule in docs/features/off-host-backup.md holds, and print "off-host asserted; not verified" beside the mode for a directory target; a table test over the rule covers `local_backed_up` and every named reason
A failed push, a refused capture, a missing copy and a stale copy are each visible in `backup status`, in `doctor` and as one reminder line in `next`, and tests in the repository cover each case
docs/shipped.md has a row for each shipped backup word, and the accepted-risk sentence in docs/roadmap.md says what the shipped feature does and does not protect against

completion.summary: Off-host backup epic delivered. The store copy at a directory target, with honest local_backed_up, push, status, doctor/next reporting, restore and docs, landed across ba2e919, c562a70, ad70ec6, bcf4f5a and ca0af27. The final changeset, the visibility tests (tests/backup_visibility_cli.rs), landed as 5da6a4e. Gate test-3353e20f passed on freeze 9ab69724; the review pair found nothing Medium or higher; the independent evaluation 4e633094 passed 4/4. Readiness was ready on all 4 stores; build 92d7b912734d installed.
